name: PercentInput
description:
A percentage, 0–100 by default, with the % as a unit and tabular figures. The value is a
whole percent, or a fraction with `scale="fraction"`; bounds are in the same scale as the value.
signature: ({ scale, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, min, max, decimals, step, width, ...rest }: PercentInputProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Decimal places shown and kept. Default 0.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The larger keyboard increment.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower allowed value.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when blur occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when value change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required; pair it with the corresponding schema validation.

props.name: scale
props.description: whole (default): 90 means 90 %. fraction: 0.9 means 90 % (what ratios and APIs often store).

props.name: scrubLabel
props.description: A short prefix inside the box that scrubs the value when dragged ("W", "Max").

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment used by keyboard and stepper interaction.

props.name: steppers
props.description: Show the − / + steppers (default). Arrow keys always step.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width: short (port, PIN), medium (name, hostname), full (default).
